resources.string: Covers feed posts from accounts you don\'t follow
Reads the feed on screen in Instagram and LinkedIn so it can cover posts you did not choose to see. Nothing is sent anywhere: the app has no internet permission.
FocusTube needs accessibility access to read what is on screen. Turn it on under Installed apps.
Posts from accounts you don\'t follow
LinkedIn: posts your network only reacted to
Off, you still see what your connections liked or commented on.
LinkedIn: \"People you may know\" and similar cards

This app has no internet permission, so it cannot send anything anywhere. It only receives screen content from Instagram and LinkedIn — the system enforces that list. Nothing is stored except the switches above.
